tasks.short: Interview clients and record the properties they are seeking.

steps.what: Open a blank profile before the client sits down.
Interview clients about the kinds of properties they are seeking.
Write the properties the client is seeking into fields.

loop.output: Area, size, type, budget and must-not fields
loop.check: Agent corrects any field that the notes do not support
loop.stop: One pass; a soft wish stays as text, not a hard filter
loop.why_not_simpler: People describe homes in phrases a form will not catch

steps.what: Send the seeking profile back to the clients for a correction.

tasks.design: The {CRM} holds an empty buyer profile. The agent interviews the client and checks a draft of the fields. The profile is sent back only after that check, and soft wishes stay as text.
tasks.previous_blocker: Wishes lived in a notebook, so the next search started from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: A fixed set of fields can hold area, size, type and budget. The interview cannot be a form.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing the constraint the client has not said as a number.
tasks.human_edge: The agent notices which wish is firm and which is polite.

ambition.what: The same day, the agent decides which wishes are hard filters and which stay as notes.

tasks.altitude: Interviews stay. The agent no longer retypes them before a search, and can refuse a search that has no confirmed profile.

reach.task: Decide which buyer wishes the agency treats as hard filters
reach.learn: Which wishes the broker will not let a search ignore

evidence.claim: Turning an interview into search fields is a records task. The conversation stays with the agent.
A buyer profile is personal data and needs a lawful basis before it is reused.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from an empty profile to a confirmed wish profile. Running the property list is a later task.
Fields: area, minimum size, type, stated budget, and free-text must-nots. The client produces them in the interview. Fallback: leave a field blank.
Configure {CRM} fields before a new store. Runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 3 hours covers new wish fields. This design does not record the interview.
unknowns: Whether interviews happen in the office or only by phone.
Which wishes clients already fill on a web form.
research_questions: What share of wish profiles are corrected by the client after the interview?

incremental.description: Add or retire wish fields when the agency changes its search

approvals.approved_version: wish profile version the agent checked

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the interview is the whole task and notes stay messy, so almost nothing shrinks. High: fields extract cleanly and only the interview and a short check remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Promote a property through the listing service, ads and an open house.

steps.what: Draft listing text from the property fields, with no new photos.

loop.input: Property fields already on the listing
loop.check: Every claim must trace to a field
loop.stop: One draft; an unsourced claim is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text praise is not in the fields

steps.what: Publish the approved text to the listing service.
Host the open house and promote the property in person.
Choose the advertisements and the spend limit.
Read enquiry mail after the open house.

tasks.design: Listing text is drafted only from property fields and published to the listing service after the agent checks it. The agent hosts the open house. Advertisements run only inside a spend limit the agent set. Photos are the real ones; this build does not restyle them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Listing text, portal entry and ad booking were three separate retypes, and photo edits were informal.
tasks.enabler_now: Fields can fill a paragraph and a portal form. An open house cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Reading a room of visitors, and deciding what an ad may claim.
tasks.human_edge: The agent knows which sentence would overclaim this home.

ambition.what: The agent sets an advertisement spend limit before any campaign runs, instead of booking it in the portal and noticing later.

tasks.altitude: Open houses stay. The agent can withhold a listing or an ad that is not the checked version.

reach.task: Set the agency cap on advertisement spend
reach.learn: The cap the broker expects on a single listing

evidence.claim: A listing portal offers an AI restyle of a home's photos.
An AI-edited photo of a real home must be labelled.
A housing site still showed many such photos and acted when people reported them.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: from property fields to a live listing, one open house, and ads inside a limit.
Fields: rooms, size, price, energy label, and the sentences the agent already stored. Producer is the listing record. Fallback: the agent writes a line the draft cut.
Do not restyle photos. The cited capability exists; the labelling duty and the reported leftovers are why this design uses the original photos.
Configure the listing export and the ad schedule before custom code. Ad-platform fees are why run cost is medium. Platform runtime is not agent time.
Upkeep of 4 hours covers banned phrases and the spend cap. Enquiry replies that need judgement stay manual.
unknowns: Whether the agency already exports listings without retyping.
research_questions: What share of listing sentences today are not traceable to a field?

incremental.description: Maintain banned phrases and the advertisement spend cap

approvals.approved_version: advertisement instruction with the spend limit

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: text rarely matches fields and every enquiry needs a written answer, so the open house and the mail dominate. High: standard facts publish cleanly and only the open house, the spend decision and odd enquiries remain. Photo restyle is not in either case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Accompany buyers on visits and advise on suitability and value.

steps.what: Accompany buyers with a one-page sheet of known defects.
Accompany buyers on the visit and advise on suitability.
Write what the buyers said about suitability and value.

loop.input: The agent's notes from the visit
loop.output: Visit note on suitability and value
loop.check: Agent deletes any comment the buyers did not make
loop.why_not_simpler: The note must follow the visit, not the listing brochure

steps.what: Log homes the buyers still want after the inspections.

tasks.design: A one-page sheet lists known defects before the visit. The agent accompanies the buyers and advises on the spot. Notes afterwards keep only what was said, and the homes they still want are marked on the {CRM}.
tasks.previous_blocker: The agent arrived from memory, and the feedback lived in mail.
tasks.enabler_now: Known defects are already fields. The advice in the room is not.
tasks.still_hard: Saying whether this home fits this buyer while standing in it.
tasks.human_edge: The agent sees the buyer's reaction to the actual rooms.
tasks.altitude: Visits stay the day. The agent walks in knowing the recorded defects and does not rebuild the feedback mail.

reach.task: Review a visit note that contradicts the listing
reach.learn: When a defect must be escalated before the next offer

evidence.claim: Advising on a visit stays with the person. A defect list can be filled from listing fields.
Buyer reactions in a note are personal data.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: one visit, including the advice given there. Setting the asking price is a different task.
Fields on the sheet: recorded defects, size, asking price. Producer is the listing. Fallback: a blank defect line if none is stored.
Configure a {CRM} note type before a new app.
Upkeep of 2 hours covers the sheet columns. The visit is not recorded.
unknowns: Whether a defect list exists before the first visit.
How many homes are visited in one outing.
research_questions: What share of visit comments never get back onto the listing?

incremental.description: Keep the defect columns on the visit sheet current

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: there is no defect data, so the sheet is written by hand and the visit is unchanged. High: the sheet is ready and only the note shrinks. The visit itself stays.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise sellers on changes that would make the home more appealing.

steps.what: Walk the home with the sellers and note what is not appealing.
Draft how the sellers could make the home more appealing.

loop.check: Each item must come from a note
loop.stop: One draft; a generic styling tip with no note is cut
loop.why_not_simpler: Appeal is specific to this home

steps.what: Advise the sellers on the appealing changes worth doing.
Send the sellers the appealing-changes list they accepted.

tasks.design: The agent walks the home with the sellers and notes what is off. A list is drafted only from those notes. The agent advises which changes are worth doing, and sends only the accepted list. No photo restyle is applied.
tasks.previous_blocker: Advice was spoken once and then lost, so sellers redid the wrong jobs.
tasks.enabler_now: Notes can become a list. Choosing what a buyer will care about cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Judging which flaw will actually stop a buyer.
tasks.human_edge: The agent has seen what buyers in this price band refuse.

ambition.what: The agent decides, on the walk-through, which changes are worth the seller's money before any work is booked.

tasks.altitude: The walk-through and the advice stay. The seller leaves with a list instead of a recollection. The class prior says automate; the work is advice in the home, so the visit stays.

reach.task: Set which presentation standards the agency asks of every seller
reach.learn: The minimum the broker expects before a listing goes live

evidence.claim: Advising a seller on presentation stays with the agent. A list can be drafted from visit notes.
An AI-edited photo of a real home would have to be labelled, so this task does not restyle photos.

assumptions: Focal role is the sales agent. Boundary: one home, from the walk-through to the sent list. Ordering contractors is out of scope.
Fields: room, flaw, suggested change, seller accepts yes or no. Producer is the agent during the walk. Fallback: the list stays as the agent's own sentences if the draft adds items.
The O*NET class prior is automate. The hard part is judgement in the home, so the design keeps the visit and the advice.
Upkeep of 3 hours covers the list headings. No photo model is in the build.
unknowns: Whether sellers already receive a written list.
research_questions: What share of suggested changes does the seller accept on the day?

incremental.description: Keep the preparation headings aligned with what buyers are refusing

approvals.approved_version: prep list version discussed with the seller

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every home is different, the draft is discarded, and both conversations stay at today's length. High: the list saves a rewrite and the conversations stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Interviews, open houses, visits and seller walk-throughs stay. Listings and wish profiles go out only as checked versions, and photos are not restyled.
reach: Real estate brokers: caps on ad spend and presentation standards
skills_to_grow: Marking hard wishes versus soft ones
Cutting a listing sentence that has no field
Writing a visit note the next offer can use
role.ambitious_version: A buyer leaves the interview with a confirmed profile, and a seller leaves the walk-through with an accepted preparation list.
